skirmish.module.zoom.name: Zoom
skirmish.module.zoom.description: Hold the key to zoom in. The mouse wheel changes the zoom while the key is held.
skirmish.module.zoom.setting.factor.tool: How many times narrower the view gets when the key is pressed
skirmish.module.zoom.setting.scroll.tool: While the key is held, the wheel zooms in and out instead of changing the hotbar slot
skirmish.module.zoom.setting.smooth.tool: Ease into the zoom instead of jumping
skirmish.module.zoom.setting.lower_sensi: The camera turns slower by the same factor as the zoom
skirmish.module.zoom.setting.hide_hand.t: Don't draw the hand and held item while zoomed
